summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing that it and the Sellers Representative of ScoutDI AS mutually terminated the October 6, 2026 Share Sale and Purchase Agreement under which Beam would have acquired all outstanding shares of the Norwegian drone company. The outside date of November 4, 2026 passed without closing; citing unfavorable U.S. public-market conditions, neither side extended. No termination fee applies, no cash or stock consideration will be paid or issued, and each party bears its own costs. The companies will explore alternative manufacturing and distribution arrangements. Watch for any replacement commercial deal, which would lack definitive terms.
